bugs.error_message: UAT G-09-7: after re-enabling tool awareness, ?? list shows 3 results then dwindles to zero — empty Zellij modal (only legend/controls visible)
bugs.root_cause: On candidate arrival the layout effect first reports the stale initialQuery render (0 visible -> no-matches estimate, pane height 9) before the reset clears the query and reports the full list (height 24). syncZellijFloatingPaneHeight spawns a detached zellij action per call with no ordering; when the shrink finishes last (~25-50% of runs) the pane stays 9 rows, the list goes to pane scrollback, and Ink never repaints (tty.WriteStream on /dev/tty never emits resize). Independent of QQ_TOOL_AWARENESS.
bugs.fix: Fixed in 09-06 with two mechanisms. (1) src/ui/CandidateSelect.tsx: the candidate-arrival reset (selection, Tab toggles, non-matching lbuffer query) runs during render via a prevCandidates useState, so React retries before commit and the layout effect never reports the stale initialQuery 'no matches' height. (2) src/client/zellij-pane-resize.ts: syncZellijFloatingPaneHeight is a serialized latest-wins queue (one zellij action at a time, newest waiting height wins, released on exit, child 'error' or a 2 s RESIZE_SETTLE_TIMEOUT_MS kill). Regression tests: tests/candidate-select-layout.test.tsx (real-hooks Ink render) and tests/zellij-pane-resize.test.ts (completion-order model). SIGWINCH wiring for the /dev/tty stream not done (not needed once both are fixed).

bugs.error_message: top `queque ›` line clipped when the modal is resized in Zellij (SCROLL: 0/1, blank last row)
bugs.root_cause: Ink's trailing cursor row was not counted in the pane height: Ink 7 writes an interactive frame shorter than its rows as output + '\n', so an N-line frame takes N + 1 PTY rows, but resolveZellijPaneHeight gave the pane N + 2 rows with 2 used by the border and title, leaving N. The terminal scrolled the header row into pane scrollback.
bugs.fix: Added module-private INK_TRAILING_CURSOR_ROWS = 1 next to ZELLIJ_FLOATING_FRAME_LINES; resolveZellijPaneHeight returns content + frame rows + cursor row (min 6, QQ_PANE_HEIGHT cap unchanged). Real-Ink regression case (e) in tests/candidate-select-layout.test.tsx; queue-test heights +1.

bugs.error_message: Daemon decoded IPC input per chunk (chunk.toString()); a 60 KB envelope split into 8 chunks gained 12 U+FFFD characters, garbling non-ASCII queryText/cwd (09.1 WR-01)
bugs.root_cause: Each socket chunk was decoded on its own, so a multi-byte UTF-8 character split across chunk boundaries became replacement characters. The 256 KB limit also compared UTF-16 code units (buf.length) with bytes (chunk.length).
bugs.fix: socket.setEncoding('utf8') (StringDecoder keeps split code points) and measure the limit with Buffer.byteLength on both sides. Tests split a request inside a 3-byte char and send a 270 KB/90k-unit request.

bugs.error_message: A prewarmed claude -p child that hangs before init (stale after laptop sleep/long idle) used the whole 25 s budget and ended as 'Claude timed out' with no cold retry (09.1 WR-02)
bugs.root_cause: The cold retry only ran for reason exit-without-result; nothing bounded the write -> init time of a warm child (29-52 ms when healthy), so a stall surfaced only as the never-retried budget timeout.
bugs.fix: runClaudeTurn takes initDeadlineMs and fails as 'stale-prewarm' (terminates the child) when no init arrives in time; claude-cli passes 1500 ms (+ the rest of a 3000 ms boot allowance for a freshly spawned child, via spawnedAt from takePrewarmed) on warm turns and retries stale-prewarm cold. A stall after init is still not detected.

bugs.error_message: Daemon shutdown retired the prewarm slot but left the pool enabled, so an in-flight query's finally { schedulePrewarm } spawned a new idle claude (~190 MB) after retirePrewarmed(); in-flight turn children were also never aborted (09.1 WR-03)
bugs.root_cause: shutdown() called retirePrewarmed() (slot only) instead of disablePrewarm(), and server.close() waits for open connections instead of ending them, so turn children kept running and their kill timers died with process.exit.
bugs.fix: New shutdownDaemon(server, connections): disablePrewarm(), destroy every tracked connection (its close aborts the turn, runClaudeTurn SIGTERMs the child), then exit after SIGKILL_GRACE_MS+100 when any were in flight so the SIGKILL backstop can fire. trackConnections(server) records sockets.

bugs.error_message: A filter typed while 'thinking…' showed was wiped when the first streamed row did not match it, so later matching rows appeared unfiltered (09.1 WR-04)
bugs.root_cause: The first-arrival branch cleared any query that matched nothing in `candidates`, which under streaming is a single row; it did not check whether the query was still the lbuffer pre-filter (the later-arrival branch already did, Pitfall 9).
bugs.fix: Guard the first-arrival clear with `query === (initialQuery ?? '')`, so only the untouched lbuffer pre-filter is cleared (D-09). Real-hooks regression test in candidate-select-layout.test.tsx.

bugs.error_message: When a later candidates array triggered the zero-match clear, the arrival branch chose the next highlight index and the useEffect(() => setSelectedIndex(0), [query]) then reset it to 0 (09.1 WR-05)
bugs.root_cause: The selection reset lived in an effect keyed on `query`, so it also fired for the render-phase arrival branch's own setQuery(''), after commit, undoing the index that branch had set (and committing one render with the stale index first).
bugs.fix: Removed the [query] effect and reset the selection in the key handlers that change the query (printable input; Backspace when the query is non-empty). Mocked effect-count test updated to 2 and now checks the handler reset; real-hooks tests for the kept position and for typing/Backspace.

bugs.error_message: Arrow keys on an empty visible list (typed filter while rows stream in) set selectedIndex to NaN ((i + 1) % 0) or -1, which survived later arrivals: no row highlighted, arrows stuck, Enter silently picked visible[0] (09.1 WR-06)
bugs.root_cause: The arrow handlers wrapped modulo/over visible.length without guarding length 0, and the later-arrival branch carried Math.min(selectedIndex, ...) forward, which keeps NaN and -1.
bugs.fix: Arrow handlers return early when no row is visible (up also wraps on i <= 0), and the later-arrival branch clamps a non-finite or negative index to 0 before Math.min. Real-hooks it.each test for up and down.

bugs.error_message: SDK path kept max_tokens 1024 while effort can be high/xhigh/max with adaptive thinking; a cut-off answer like `[{"command": "find . -name` went through parseCandidates' prose fallback and became a selectable command (or `echo ""` with no text) (09.1 WR-07)
bugs.root_cause: Thinking tokens count against max_tokens and stop_reason was never checked, so a truncated response with no streamed row fell to the 'not JSON' branch of parseCandidates.
bugs.fix: max_tokens raised to SDK_MAX_TOKENS (16000, a ceiling on a streamed request); on stop_reason max_tokens with no strict list and no streamed rows, scan the text for closed candidate objects and fail closed with 'QueQue: Claude response was truncated' when there are none.

bugs.error_message: User reported: only the third test fials.... when i type into the filter before candidates are populated, my filter text is appeneded onto the query text from the left of the `?` so "how to use z3" becomes "how to use z3 smt".... the filter value should be empty upon opening of the modal as the query text is displayed above this
bugs.root_cause: AND-gate: (1) CandidateSelect seeded the FILTER query with the lbuffer (`useState(initialQuery ?? '')`, 03.1 D-01 pre-filter) and printable keys append to it, so text typed during `thinking…` extended the lbuffer; (2) the 09.1 WR-04 guard ran the arrival zero-match clears only while `query === initialQuery`, so once the user typed, the lbuffer+typed string was never cleared and the completed list showed `no matches`. The lbuffer already shows in the `queque ›` header (phase 04), so the seed was redundant.
bugs.fix: Plan 09.1-09: seed the query with '' (FILTER opens on the `type to filter…` placeholder) and remove both arrival-time zero-match clears (they only undid the seed); keep the first-arrival selection/Tab reset, later-arrival keep-highlight and the WR-06 clamp; initialQuery documented as header + layout estimator only. New real-Ink G-09.1-5 describe (UAT case, empty lbuffer, typed text equal to the lbuffer); tests that encoded the pre-fill rewritten to the new contract, none deleted.

bugs.error_message: CR-01: Backspace is silently dropped when it arrives in the same stdin read as earlier keystrokes (regression from the WR-05 fix). Verifier reproduction: one chunk with `a` and DEL left `FILTER: a`; `ab` and two DELs left `FILTER: ab`.
bugs.root_cause: The WR-05 fix made the Backspace branch guard on the render-closure query (`query.length > 0`). Ink 7 splits one stdin read into several key events and runs them back to back through useInput (useEffectEvent = handler of the last committed render) while React batches the updates, so a Backspace after typed keys in the same read saw the pre-read (empty) query and was dropped. Enter, Tab and the arrows read the same closure query/selectedIndex/installToggled, so Down+Enter in one read inserted row 0.
bugs.fix: Plan 09.1-10: a `pendingInput` ref (PendingInput: query, selectedIndex, installToggled) tagged with a per-render `renderToken`; every key handler reads that live snapshot and writes it back through `applyInput` (value setters, each only on change). Real-Ink one-chunk tests (`ab`+2 DEL, `a`+DEL, mid-stream edits) and a one-key-per-read vs one-read invariance it.each for Enter/Tab/arrows, plus mocked same-closure cases. No test deleted.
